subtitle.description: Flavor title printed on the card under the name (e.g. 'Master Tactician', 'Dark Lord of the Sith'). Distinct from the parenthetical variant tags already folded into some units' `name` (e.g. 'Stormtroopers (Heavy Response Unit)') -- those remain part of `name` for id-stability; this field is purely the character's epithet.

rank.description: 'attached' is not one of the six standard army-building ranks -- it's for companion/detachment units (e.g. a Counterpart droid, a weapon-upgrade-granted sub-unit) that aren't independently selected in list building. Added because real extracted card data included units of this kind; confirm against rules text before relying on it for list validation.

unit_types.description: Overlap is expected and allowed -- e.g. a droid unit is also a trooper for most rules purposes; a creature-mounted rider may be trooper+creature.

resilience.description: Distinct from courage -- vehicles use resilience, not courage, per real card data. Mutually exclusive with courage in practice.

attack_surge.description: e.g. 'hit', 'crit', 'none' -- what the attack surge icon converts to on this unit's default profile.

defense_surge.description: e.g. 'block', 'none' -- what the defense surge icon converts to.

keywords_resolved_to_library.description: false means stats.keywords contains raw printed keyword strings (with card parameters, e.g. 'Precise 1') that have NOT been cross-referenced/mapped to ids in data/keywords.json. Many won't resolve at all since keywords.json's E-Z range is itself unverified/incomplete.
